Focused searches and review of available issuer-attributed materials did not resolve the export-share figures. The official TWSE annual-report PDF link timed out when opened; no further reliable source located the required period and denominator.
The available annual-report material and company product pages do not establish the three claimed export percentages.
A secondary source reports 2024 country shares of product sales, not the claimed export-only or geosynthetic-export denominator; those figures are not treated as confirmation or contradiction.
Product application descriptions do not prove that 惠光 supplied specific projects in the named countries.
